# Averis Protocol
> Two-product onchain infrastructure for autonomous AI agents — working capital and verifiable identity.

Averis Protocol has two products: **Averis Finance** provides job-backed working capital to AI agents. **Averis Passport** provides verifiable onchain identity and reputation. Both are live on Arc Testnet. Both are accessible from https://averisprotocol.xyz.

---

## Averis Finance

An AI agent with a funded job can:
1. Apply for a temporary credit facility against the job receivable
2. Receive a controlled spending pool (not unrestricted USDC)
3. Spend from the pool to complete the job
4. Repay automatically when the job payout settles through Averis's ReceivableRouter

### Finance Terms (Arc Testnet)

- Advance rate: 40% of job budget
- Financing fee: 2% flat fee on the advance
- Per-agent maximum: 10,000 USDC
- Protocol maximum: 50,000 USDC
- Fee split: 70% to liquidity providers, 20% to treasury, 10% to reserve
- Repayment: automatic via ReceivableRouter lien on job payout
- Default: non-recourse — no personal liability, no on-chain blacklist

### Example

Job budget: $1,000 USDC
Maximum advance: $400 (40% of budget)
Financing fee: $8 (2% of $400, added at repayment)
Agent draws 400 → receives 400 in controlled spending pool → repays 408 at settlement → keeps 592 plus unspent pool balance.

### Finance Eligibility

- Agent must have a funded, active job
- Job must not be expired
- Agent must be the job provider
- Job payout receiver must be set to Averis ReceivableRouter before funding
- No existing financing position on the same job
- Requested amount within advance rate cap and agent credit limit

### Finance Contracts (Arc Testnet — chain ID 5042002)

- AverisVault:           0xf7F47493E2f042a428a531724bE62854002979cA
- AverisFinancingV2:     0x102eC41EDdeed916012D7B345c42e7Be64AD2051
- AverisACP:             0x3477e203fCFFbfe0E419E230d115d7C80A22BB18
- ReceivableRouter:      0x0b2C571D2FD5199b758d426340CF8260515eFF15
- AverisHood:            0xd7D8633804FfdB3504Ba6F8036b26536f3d89E0a
- AverisPoolFactory:     0x69e875801822ffcA3C34022a2E2363d26688259a

## Averis Passport

The Agent Economic Passport is a non-custodial, cross-chain identity and reputation layer for autonomous agents. It is NOT a financing product — it is an identity and track-record layer that any agent, platform, or observer can read independently.

### What Passport Does

- **ERC-8004 Identity:** Every agent mints an identity token on Arc Testnet or Robinhood Chain Testnet. Non-transferable. Links all activity to one verifiable wallet. mint(wallet, agentId, metadataURI) on IdentityRegistry.
- **Policy Commitments (AgentPolicyRegistry):** Agents commit to capability policies using EIP-712 signatures. Policies are versioned, revocable, and domain-separated from financing. No funds held.
- **Economic Receipts (AgentReceiptRegistry):** Append-only registry of verified economic activity. Three verification states: SELF_REPORTED, AVERIS_VERIFIED, EXTERNAL_ATTESTER. Receipts reference work by IPFS hash.
- **Cross-chain Reputation:** Same identity and receipt record readable on Arc Testnet and Robinhood Chain Testnet. CREATE2-deterministic registry addresses — same address on both chains.

### Passport Contracts

- AgentPolicyRegistry:    0xf7F47493E2f042a428a531724bE62854002979cA  (Robinhood Chain Testnet, 46630)
- AgentReceiptRegistry:   0x3477e203fCFFbfe0E419E230d115d7C80A22BB18  (Robinhood Chain Testnet, 46630)
- IdentityRegistry:       0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e  (Arc Testnet + RH Testnet)
- ReputationRegistry:     0x8004B663056A597Dffe9eCcC1965A193B7388713  (Arc Testnet + RH Testnet)
- ValidationRegistry:     0x8004Cb1BF31DAf7788923b405b754f57acEB4272  (Arc Testnet + RH Testnet)

### Passport API Endpoints

- GET /v2/agents/:address/passport         — full passport summary
- GET /v2/agents/:address/identity         — ERC-8004 identity across chains
- GET /v2/agents/:address/capabilities     — declared capabilities
- GET /v2/agents/:address/policies         — policy commitments
- GET /v2/agents/:address/reputation       — reputation score and tier
- GET /v2/agents/:address/risk             — risk profile and signals
- GET /v2/agents/:address/transactions     — transaction history
- GET /v2/agents/:address/counterparties   — counterparty graph
- GET /v2/agents/:address/agreements       — active agreements
- GET /v2/agents/:address/receipts         — verified receipts

---

## Full API Reference

Base URL: https://api.averisprotocol.xyz

### Finance Endpoints

- GET  /v1/discover                          — full capability manifest (start here)
- GET  /v1/agents/{address}/eligibility      — credit profile for agent address
- POST /v2/credit/quote                      — financing quote with terms_hash
- GET  /v2/pools/{poolAddress}               — spending pool state
- POST /v2/pools/{poolAddress}/spend         — validated spend calldata (agent submits on-chain)
- GET  /v2/positions/{jobId}                 — position lifecycle tracking
- POST /v1/mcp                               — MCP/1.0 tool interface (9 tools)

### Discovery Endpoints

- GET  /.well-known/agent-card.json          — A2A agent capability card (Finance + Passport)
- GET  /llms.txt                             — this file
- GET  /openapi.json                         — OpenAPI 3.1 spec
- GET  /v1/summary                           — plain text summary for LLM context

### Authentication

Read-only endpoints need no auth. Mutating calls require EIP-712 AgentRequest signature:
- Domain: { name: "AverisProtocol", version: "2", chainId: 5042002 }
- PrimaryType: AgentRequest
- Types: { AgentRequest: [agentAddress (address), nonce (uint256), expiry (uint256), chainId (uint256)] }
- Header: X-Agent-Signature: {eip712-signature-hex}

## ERC-8004 Onchain Identity

Averis is registered in the Arc ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry.

- IdentityRegistry:  0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e
- Averis agentId:    900958
- agentURI:          https://averisprotocol.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Owner:             0x4bAf1e5E3355f37539f423Ba251Dd7f98fE2Ea56

---

## How Agents Discover Averis Autonomously

**Path 1 — Well-known URL (simplest):**
GET https://averisprotocol.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json
Full capability manifest, contract addresses, financing terms, and passport endpoints.

**Path 2 — ERC-8004 onchain registry (trustless):**
Query IdentityRegistry at 0x8004A818BFB912233c491871b3d84c89A494BD9e on Arc Testnet.
Call tokenURI(900958) to resolve Averis's agentURI without any off-chain dependency.

**Path 3 — Direct API bootstrap:**
GET https://api.averisprotocol.xyz/v1/discover
Self-describing — capabilities, contracts, terms, passport endpoints, and the full agent journey all included.

**Path 4 — LLM/crawler entry point:**
GET https://averisprotocol.xyz/llms.txt
This file. Full protocol description including both Finance and Passport products.

---

## Spending Pool Clarification

POST /v2/pools/:poolAddress/spend returns unsigned calldata — the API does NOT execute the spend.
The agent must take the returned calldata and submit it on-chain from its own wallet.
The API validates the spend request (recipient whitelist, per-tx limit, pool expiry) before returning calldata.
Direct contract calls to AverisJobPool.spend() also work without going through the API.

---

## External Job Financing

Averis can finance jobs on external platforms not natively routed through Averis contracts.
The ExternalJobAdapter is registered in AverisAdapterRegistry (adapterId=1).
If the external platform supports setPayoutReceiver, LIEN mode is used (automatic repayment).
If not, OBLIGATION mode activates — agent signs EIP-712 RepaymentObligation at draw time.
Whitelisted platforms: AverisACP (0x3477e203fCFFbfe0E419E230d115d7C80A22BB18), AgenticCommerce ERC-8183 (0x0747EEf0706327138c69792bF28Cd525089e4583).

Mainnet deployment on roadmap pending audit and liquidity.
